notes: 626 Abs.2 Ziff.2: 'maximale Dauer der Verträge ... Kündigungsfrist' plus 735b Abs.2 'höchstens ein Jahr'; both needed, consistent DE/FR/IT. de=1 driven by common company-law terms (Statuten, Verwaltungsrat), not copied phrasing.

Fact 1 supported: 'Verbot fällt ferner dahin, wenn der Arbeitgeber ... kündigt' (340c Abs.2). Fact 2 (employee terminates) is irrelevant to the employer-termination scenario and would penalise correct answers. de=1; 'keinen Anlass dazu gegeben' mirrors 'begründeten Anlass gegeben'.
fix: Delete fact 2. Question: '... Mein Chef hat mir jetzt gekündigt, obwohl ich ihm keinen Grund dafür geliefert habe. Muss ich mich trotzdem an diese Klausel halten?'

notes: Facts 2-3 supported: 'beruht auf einer Anmeldung. Die einzutragenden Tatsachen sind zu belegen' (929). Fact 1 (truthfulness of entries) is not asked. Closest others: 931 (duty to register), 937 (examination); neither answers. it=27.
fix: Delete fact 1 (entries must be true and not misleading); keep facts 2 and 3.

notes: 'verringert sich der Haftungsbetrag ... jedes Jahr um drei Hundertstel' (500 Abs.1); fixed loan keeps it outside Abs.2 exceptions. Same in FR/IT (3 %). No competing article. No lexical signal.

'le voiturier doit aviser l'expéditeur et garder provisoirement la chose' (444). Non-perishable excludes 445; 92/93 are general creditor-default rules, less specific to the carrier. fr=1 from everyday words (marchandise, destinataire).

'auch auf Unternehmen Anwendung finden, die mit Rohstoffen handeln' (964i). 964d defines scope (extraction only) and implies no direct coverage, but only 964i answers the trader question. No lexical overlap (de=2464).

'rimborsarle le spese del viaggio di ritorno ... entro sei mesi' (406b); Abs.3 caps client's reimbursement. 406d Ziff.3 (contract must state the max) partly overlaps fact 2 but not fact 1. it=1 helped by 'viaggio di ritorno' (title term), acceptable everyday phrase.

684a Abs.1 'le transfert d'actions est nul si la société n'a plus d'activité'; 684a Abs.3 reserves 934, which gives deletion procedure. Second article genuinely needed. fr=1 from generic terms (actions, registre du commerce).

Fact 2 supported: 'gesetzliche Vertretung ... hat den Arbeitgeber ... nach Kräften zu unterstützen' (345 Abs.2). Fact 1 (apprentice's own duty) is explicitly excluded by 'Apart from what my child has to do'. 344a/345a do not state parent duties.
fix: Delete fact 1 (apprentice must strive to reach the goal); keep fact 2 only.

notes: 'qui ont réalisé un chiffre d'affaires inférieur à 500 000 francs ... ne tiennent qu'une comptabilité des recettes' (957 al.2). Same-language control, fr=1 expected. Minor: fact 1 says 'above'; DE/IT say 'at least' 500 000; not decisive for 300 000.
'beginnt die Verjährung für das Forderungsrecht im Ganzen mit dem Zeitpunkte, in dem die erste rückständige Leistung' (131). 128 Ziff.1 gives the length only. de=31, control item.
'non è responsabile ... se non in caso di dolo o di grave negligenza' (248). Art. 41 general tort is displaced for donors. Consistent DE/FR/IT. it=639.
'Der Schenker kann den Rückfall der geschenkten Sache an sich selbst vorbehalten' and Grundbuch Vormerkung (247). 210:436 concerns a different reversion; no competitor. No lexical signal.

335f Abs.1 consultation; 335g Abs.1, 2 and 4 '30 giorni dopo la notifica'. Both needed. Control item (src it), it=1 helped by the official name 'ufficio cantonale del lavoro'; acceptable as a layperson would use it. Assumes the 335d threshold is met.

'La majorité des deux tiers ... pour la révision des statuts' (888 al.2). Twins 704 (SA) and 808/808b (Sàrl) are excluded by 'coopérative'; 889 not triggered. Fact 3 (articles may be stricter) contradicts the premise 'si les statuts ne disent rien'. fr=1, 'élections' copied but generic.
fix: Delete fact 3 (the articles may set stricter requirements); keep facts 1 and 2.

notes: 'Der Vermieter kann die Zustimmung nur aus wichtigem Grund verweigern' and 'höchstens aber für zwei Jahre' (263). 262 is subletting; 292 only points back to 263 for Pacht. de=31.
'Le proposte si considerano accettate, se hanno ottenuto l'assenso di almeno due terzi' (1171 cpv.2). 1170 covers a single community only. it=9, mild overlap.
'Die Leibrente ist halbjährlich und zum voraus zu leisten' and 'so wird der volle Betrag geschuldet' (518). No competitor. No lexical signal for EN.
'le débiteur a le droit de consigner la chose aux frais et risques du créancier' and 'Le juge décide du lieu' (92). 93 is sale; 444 carrier-specific. fr=3, paraphrased.
'ist nur gültig, wenn: a. ... mindestens drei Jahre' (269c). 269b (indexed rent) is a different mechanism; 270d procedural. de=4, paraphrased.

329b Abs.3 lit.c 'den Urlaub des andern Elternteils nach Artikel 329g' and 329g Abs.2-3; both needed. But 329b Abs.4 lets a standard or collective employment contract derogate from Abs.3 if overall equivalent; fact 1 states the ban as absolute.
fix: Fact 1: 'The employer may not reduce the worker's holidays because the worker took the other-parent leave, unless a standard or collective employment contract provides a different arrangement that is at least equivalent overall for the worker.'

notes: 'La revoca ... entro un anno dal giorno in cui il donatore ne ha conosciuto la causa' and heirs for the remainder (251). 249 gives grounds only. it=207.

'behält sie die juristische Persönlichkeit und führt ihre bisherige Firma, jedoch mit dem Zusatz «in Liquidation»' (739). Only article with that wording; GmbH/cooperative refer to AG rules (826, 913), not twins.
'Les lois cantonales ne peuvent déroger ... se rattachant à l'exercice d'une industrie' (61 al.2). Communal employees are public employees. fr=111.

'Sie gelten nicht für Ferienwohnungen, die für höchstens drei Monate gemietet werden' (253a). 253b is a different exclusion. de=1 is mostly ordinary words; 'Ferienwohnung' is the natural term and only matches as a different token.

1182 covers only decisions under 1180/1181. A 'modifica' of the loan terms is a 1170 measure (cpv.8) needing cantonal approval; challenge then runs via 1178 ('ricorrere ... allorché ... viola la legge', 30 days). Also DE 1182 says 'binnen 30 Tagen', FR/IT 'un mese'; fact 2 must cover both.
fix: Q: 'Ho obbligazioni di un'impresa. L'assemblea degli obbligazionisti ha preso a maggioranza una decisione che non tocca i nostri diritti di creditori, ma che secondo me viola la legge e le condizioni del prestito; io ho votato contro. Posso contestarla davanti a un giudice ed entro quanto tempo?' Fact 2: 'within one month (30 days in the German text) from learning of the decision.'

notes: 'unter Nennung des Namens und der Funktion des betreffenden Mitglieds' (734d). 959c (notes to accounts) is unrelated; 663c repealed. fr=10.

671 Abs.2 threshold, Abs.4 excludes 725c reserve; 725c Abs.3 dissolution. Both needed, holding excluded. Fact 1 misreads 671 Abs.1 Ziff.1 ('Erlös ... über den Nennwert und die Ausgabekosten hinaus'): issue costs are deducted, not allocated. 672 Abs.3 refers back, not a twin.
fix: Fact 1: 'The proceeds from issuing shares above their nominal value, less the issue costs, are allocated to the statutory capital reserve.'

notes: 'L'assemblée générale décide de l'augmentation ordinaire' and 'dans les six mois ... la décision est caduque' (650). Control item, fr=8. GmbH 781 refers to AG rules; not a twin given 'société anonyme'.

'gilt dem Annehmer gegenüber der Wechsel als am letzten Tage der ... Frist angenommen' (1025 Abs.2). 1015 Abs.2 requires dating/protest but not the deemed date; 1099 is promissory notes. de=1 unavoidable technical terms (Wechsel, Protest).

'Si presume che l'agente è autorizzato solo a trattare affari, a ricevere gli avvisi' (418e). But 'rappresentante esterno' can mean a salaried field representative (commesso viaggiatore), whose powers are in 348b (negotiate only, no payments or payment terms). The question must state the person is not an employee.
fix: Replace the first sentence with: 'La ditta per cui lavoro si affida a un agente indipendente, che non è suo dipendente, e che le procura clienti in modo stabile.'

notes: 'Er hat ihm die Besichtigung der Güter und Entnahme von Proben ... zu gestatten' (483). 472ff general deposit lacks these duties. No lexical signal.
'En cas d'éviction totale, la vente est réputée résiliée' and listed claims (195). 192/193/196 related but total loss stated. fr=5, paraphrased.
336d Abs.1 refers to 336c Abs.1 lit.a; 336d Abs.2 applies 336c Abs.2-3 ('ce délai est suspendu'). Both needed. fr=1 from standard terms (délai de congé, service militaire).
'so hat er schon bei blossem Zuwiderhandeln den Schaden zu ersetzen' (98 Abs.2). Easement rules not triggered by a contractual promise. de=4, paraphrased.

'convocata almeno 20 giorni prima ... abbreviarlo sino a dieci giorni' (805). AG twins 699/700 have no ten-day shortening and question names Sagl. it=1 from generic terms (assemblea dei soci, statuto).
'muss jede Partei der andern ein genaues, von ihr unterzeichnetes Verzeichnis ... übergeben' (277). 299b concerns end of lease. No lexical signal.
'Jede Partei kann verlangen, dass der Vertrag im Erstreckungsentscheid ... angepasst wird' (272c). 272/272b are conditions and length. de=2, 'angepasst' natural.
'bei Genossenschaften von weniger als 30 Mitgliedern, mindestens drei Genossenschafter' (881 Abs.2). AG 699 Abs.3/5 uses capital thresholds; question names a cooperative.
'à concurrence de 10 % du capital-actions' (659 al.2). GmbH 783 has different limits (35 %) and question names SA. fr=1 from generic terms.

964l: 'redatta in una lingua nazionale o in inglese', six months, ten years; cpv.4 refers to 958f (ten years from end of year). 964c has similar rules for the non-financial report but question names minerals and child labour. it=56.
'consenso scritto del coniuge ... anticipatamente o al più tardi simultaneamente' (494 cpv.1) and cpv.3 for increases. No competitor. it=74.
'so kann der Mieter nach den Artikeln 107-109 ... vorgehen' and Abs.2 (258). 259a ff give the content of defect claims but the handover rule is in 258. de=155.
